## Summary

Describe the problem and the chosen solution.

## Validation

- [ ] `go test ./...`
- [ ] `go vet ./...`
- [ ] Formatting checked with `gofmt`
- [ ] Parser fixtures or renderer golden files updated when applicable
- [ ] User-visible changes added to `CHANGELOG.md`

## Scope

- [ ] The change preserves parser, Schema IR, relationship, renderer, and output boundaries.
- [ ] The change does not introduce an alpha non-goal without prior agreement.
